The '''Huge Pixel Capybara''' is an {{Exclusive99}} [[List of Pets (Pet Simulator 99)|pet]] in [[Pet Simulator 99]]. 
It can be obtained from the [[Grow an Egg Event 2025 (Pet Simulator 99)|Combine-O-Matic]].
== Trivia ==
* Several [[Huge Pixel Shadow Griffin (Pet Simulator 99)|Huge Pixel Shadow Griffin]] can be converted into a Huge Pixel Capybara.
* Several Huge Pixel Capybaras can be converted into a [[Titanic Pixel Agony (Pet Simulator 99)|Titanic Pixel Agony]] using the [[Grow an Egg Event 2025 (Pet Simulator 99)|Combine-O-Matic]].
